name: model-3d
description: From a description to a production-ready 3D model: plan with real proportions, build as code (Three.js in the browser, or a Blender script with engine=blender), look from every view and fix, export .glb, validate, independent art review, revisions.

subject.description: What to model, its style and any details that must be there.

detail.default: a clean, realistic product model, under 50k triangles

engine.description: "three" (Three.js in the browser, with a viewer page) or "blender" (a bpy script run in Blender, previews rendered by Blender)

approval.description: "manual" to approve the plan first, "auto" to go straight on

plan.title: Model plan

build.title: Model & look

fix.title: Fix
fix.prompt:
The checks failed. Fix the model or viewer, re-export model.glb, confirm with model_info.

{{feedback}}

review.title: Art review
review.prompt:
Review the model against the subject and docs/model-plan.md. Write docs/model-review.md.

<subject>
{{input.subject}}
</subject>

revise.title: Revise
revise.prompt:
Address every BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/model-review.md; look at the affected views again; re-export model.glb. Add a "Resolution" line under each finding.

{{state.review}}

fix-2.title: Fix
fix-2.prompt:
The checks failed after the revision. Fix it.

{{feedback}}

final-review.title: Second review
final-review.prompt: Second review: confirm each BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/model-review.md is resolved and nothing new broke. Append a "Round 2" section.

deliver.title: Delivery note
deliver.prompt: Write docs/delivery.md: the files (model.glb, model.js, index.html), size in metres, triangles, materials, how to view it (open index.html; ?view=front|side|back|top), what the reviews found and how it was resolved, and anything still open (including any Round 2 findings not fixed). Report its first paragraph.

build-blender.title: Model in Blender & look

fix-blender.title: Fix
fix-blender.prompt:
The checks failed. Fix the Blender script (tools/model.py) or the previews (tools/preview.py), export model.glb again, render the previews again and look at them, confirm with model_info.

{{feedback}}

review-blender.title: Art review
review-blender.prompt:
Review the model against the subject and docs/model-plan.md. It was built in Blender: look at every render in previews/ (read shows images), check model.glb with model_info, and read tools/model.py for how it is built. Write docs/model-review.md.

<subject>
{{input.subject}}
</subject>

revise-blender.title: Revise
revise-blender.prompt:
Address every BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/model-review.md in the Blender script; export model.glb again, render the previews again and look at the affected views. Add a "Resolution" line under each finding.

{{state.review-blender}}

fix-blender-2.title: Fix
fix-blender-2.prompt:
The checks failed after the revision. Fix it, export and render the previews again.

{{feedback}}

final-review-blender.title: Second review
final-review-blender.prompt: Second review: look at the renders in previews/ again and confirm each BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/model-review.md is resolved and nothing new broke. Append a "Round 2" section.

deliver-blender.title: Delivery note
deliver-blender.prompt: Write docs/delivery.md: the files (model.glb, model.blend, tools/model.py, tools/preview.py, previews/*.png), size in metres, triangles, materials, how to rebuild it (blender -b --python tools/model.py) and how to view it (the previews, or model.glb in any glTF viewer), what the reviews found and how it was resolved, and anything still open (including any Round 2 findings not fixed). Report its first paragraph.
